description.para: These functions return the data stored in the value by type. The data is not coerced to the type, thus the caller should ensure the value's actual type matches the function being called. The caller can call rbusValue_GetType to get the type.

parameterdescription.para: A value to get data from.

simplesect.para: The data as a specific type. This is meant to be a const accessor. To avoid large copies, if the type is a buffer or struct type, a const pointer to the actual data is returned.

description.para: These functions check that the type being requested matches the value's actual type, and returns the data if it does. If the type does not match, an error is returned.

parameterdescription.para: A value to get data from.

simplesect.para: error code as defined by rbusValueError_t. Possible errors are: RBUS_VALUE_ERROR_TYPE

description.para: These functions set the type and data of a value.

parameterdescription.para: The type specific data to set on the value.
